item.title: Motorcycle accident on Nicosia–Limassol highway near Moni
item.description: A motorcycle accident occurred on Thursday morning on the Nicosia–Limassol highway, near Moni. According to the police, the motorcyclist lost control of his bike, causing it to come to a stop. An ambulance was dispatched to the scene to transport the motorcyclist to the hospital. Police investigations into the incident are ongoing.
